description: This file defines the CustomerMenuConfigurator class, which implements the MenuConfigurator interface to set up menu configuration for the Customer section in the OrangeHRM Time plugin. It primarily overrides the current screen to 'viewCustomers'.

classes.name: CustomerMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Implements MenuConfigurator to override the screen to 'viewCustomers' during menu configuration in the Time plugin.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the current screen to 'viewCustomers' and returns null.
